_comment: Shared writer/reader parity fixtures for the subject/header parity invariant. Each case pins a raw commit MESSAGE (the body after the git header/message split) and the subject + GitMsg header line that BOTH the Go writer (subjectOf / extractHeaderLine in site_items.go) and the JS reader (cleanContent + first line / parseGitmsg in gs-core.js) must derive from it identically. rawObject cases additionally pin the full loose-object commit text so the header/message split parity (gpgsig blocks, CRLF) is covered end to end. feedbackCards pins the review verdict and the file:line anchor label both renderers put on a feedback card. releaseHeads pins the subject and the version chip both renderers put on a release head. detailHeads pins the subject and the head chips both renderers put on a detail head. metaRow pins the meta row skeleton: the bit classes in order, and the author label and its email title both renderers derive. listEmpty pins each list route's empty sentence, which both renderers show.
